status_definitions.reproduction-verified: A published computation has been independently reconstructed within an explicitly limited scope.
status_definitions.candidate-proof: A proof package and explicit witnesses pass repository checks but remain subject to external mathematical and priority review.
status_definitions.certified-obstruction: A negative computational result has an independently checked proof certificate, but does not by itself settle the active theorem target.
status_definitions.attack-surface: A finite reduction, graph, core, or search instance prepared for further work.

claims.title: Independent reconstruction of the published n=10, k=4 coloring computation
claims.claim: The three cover graphs stated in Proposition 6 of Batmanov--Voronov admit the reported upper-bound colorings.
limitations: This package does not independently establish that the three sets form a universal covering system.
The observed color counts are upper bounds, not exact chromatic numbers.

claims.title: Candidate proof for the n=11, k=4 Boolean-cube Borsuk subcase
claims.claim: Every diameter-4 subset of the 11-dimensional Boolean cube can be partitioned into at most 12 subsets of smaller diameter.
limitations: The result has not completed external specialist review.
Novelty and priority have not been established by direct author or literature confirmation.

claims.title: Candidate proof for the n=11, k=8 Boolean-cube Borsuk subcase
claims.claim: Every diameter-8 subset of the 11-dimensional Boolean cube can be partitioned into at most 12 subsets of smaller diameter.
limitations: The result has not completed external specialist review.
Novelty and priority have not been established by direct author or literature confirmation.
The coloring is an upper-bound certificate, not an exact chromatic-number result.

claims.title: Canonical one-base attack surface for n=11, k=6
claims.claim: Every normalized nontrivial diameter-6 component containing a fixed distance-6 neighbor lies inside a canonical 692-vertex trim graph.
limitations: The trim graph contains pairs farther than 6 apart and is not a legal theorem instance.
Colorability or uncolorability of the trim graph alone does not settle the diameter-6 case.

claims.title: Certified UNSAT result for 12-coloring the canonical n=11, k=6 trim graph
claims.claim: The 692-vertex universal trim graph is not 12-colorable under the recorded exact graph-coloring formulation.
evidence_commands: cd borsuk_11_k6_trim_unsat_certificate && gunzip -c k6_trim_12color.drat.gz > proof.drat && ./drup_check k6_trim_12color.cnf proof.drat
limitations: This rejects the coarse universal cover only.
It neither disproves nor settles the n=11, k=6 Boolean-cube Borsuk case.
The next proof layer must enforce diameter compatibility or an equivalent structural restriction.

claims.title: Full n=11, k=6 Boolean-cube Borsuk subcase
claims.claim: Every diameter-6 subset of the 11-dimensional Boolean cube can be partitioned into at most 12 subsets of smaller diameter.
limitations: No complete diameter-compatible branch covering and certificate manifest currently exists.
